titleZh: 欧盟负责人为加拿大成为“准成员”敞开大门
titleEn: EU chief opens door for Canada to become 'associate member'
summaryZh: 欧盟负责人表示，加拿大可成为欧盟“准成员”。
summaryEn: The EU chief says Canada could become an “associate member” as Ottawa seeks closer ties after relations with the US broke down.
detailZh: 英国广播公司报道，欧盟负责人表示，欧盟为加拿大成为“准成员”留下空间。报道说，加拿大正寻求与欧盟建立更紧密的关系，背景是加拿大与美国的关系出现破裂，以及美国总统唐纳德·特朗普相关因素。材料未说明这一身份的具体安排、时间表或双方后续行动。目前，相关表态仍停留在开启可能性的层面。
detailEn: BBC News reports that the EU chief has opened the door to Canada becoming an “associate member” of the European Union. The report says Canada is seeking closer ties with the EU following a breakdown in relations with the United States and its president, Donald Trump. The available material does not provide details about what associate membership would involve, whether any process has begun, or what steps either side may take next. It therefore describes an opening for closer relations rather than a confirmed membership arrangement.

titleZh: OpenAI负责人称世界“有理由害怕”但应信任人工智能企业
titleEn: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
summaryZh: 奥尔特曼称世界有理由害怕人工智能，但应信任人工智能企业。
summaryEn: Sam Altman says people should fear AI’s threats to humanity while trusting AI companies.
detailZh: 英国广播公司报道称，OpenAI负责人萨姆·奥尔特曼表示，面对人工智能可能对人类构成的威胁，世界“有理由感到害怕”，但也应当信任人工智能企业。随着相关担忧加剧，奥尔特曼及其他科技公司首席执行官表示，当前存在限制人工智能进一步发展的激励因素。材料未说明这些激励因素的具体内容，也未列出人工智能可能造成的威胁，或说明相关企业将采取何种措施。
detailEn: BBC News reports that OpenAI chief Sam Altman said the world is “right to be afraid” of artificial intelligence, while also arguing that people should trust AI companies. The report says fears are growing over the threats AI poses to humanity. Altman and other technology chief executives said there are incentives to limit further advances in AI. The supplied material does not specify what those incentives are, identify the threats in greater detail, or provide further information about the companies’ views.

titleZh: 麦克尔莫被移出阵容后，谢兰美国巡演全部助演退出
titleEn: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore was dropped
summaryZh: 麦克尔莫被移出美国巡演阵容后，全部助演嘉宾退出；谢兰称自己对此不负责。
summaryEn: All support acts quit Ed Sheeran’s US tour after Macklemore was dropped; Sheeran said he was not responsible.
detailZh: 据BBC News，爱德·希兰美国巡演的全部助演嘉宾在麦克尔莫被移出巡演阵容后宣布退出。报道提到，麦克尔莫曾在舞台上发表亲巴勒斯坦言论，随后被从演出阵容中移除。希兰表示，自己并不对麦克尔莫被移出阵容负责。现有材料没有说明助演嘉宾的具体身份、退出时间、相关决定的作出方或巡演后续安排。
detailEn: BBC News reports that every support act on Ed Sheeran’s US tour has quit after Macklemore was dropped from the line-up. Macklemore had made pro-Palestinian statements on stage. Sheeran said he was not responsible for Macklemore being removed. The supplied material does not identify the support acts, explain who made the decision, state when the departures occurred, or provide further details about the tour’s future arrangements. It only describes the sequence of the line-up change, the departures and Sheeran’s statement.

titleZh: 战争受损建筑在加沙倒塌，至少20人死亡
titleEn: At least 20 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses
summaryZh: 加沙一栋战争受损建筑倒塌，至少20人死亡，数十人仍被埋在废墟下。
summaryEn: At least 20 people were killed after a war-damaged building collapsed in Gaza City; dozens remain missing beneath the rubble.
detailZh: 英国广播公司（BBC）报道称，加沙城一栋在战争中受损的建筑倒塌，至少造成20人死亡。废墟下仍有数十人失踪。报道称，倒塌前，这栋建筑内据报住着10个家庭。现有材料未说明建筑倒塌的具体时间、原因，也未提供进一步的救援和伤亡细节。相关情况仍待进一步披露。
detailEn: BBC News reports that a building in Gaza City, damaged by war, has collapsed, killing at least 20 people. Dozens of people are missing beneath the rubble. The report says that 10 families had reportedly been living in the building. The available material does not provide further information about when the collapse occurred, what caused it, the rescue operation, or whether there were additional injuries. The number of people still missing is described only as dozens, and no further details about the affected families are given.

titleZh: 五角大楼监察员确认伊朗战争导致美国弹药短缺
titleEn: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
summaryZh: 美国国防部监察员确认伊朗战争导致美军弹药短缺，补给还存在瓶颈。
summaryEn: Pentagon inspector confirms Iran war caused US munitions shortfalls and exposed a resupply bottleneck.
detailZh: 据BBC报道，美国国防部监察员确认，伊朗战争已经导致美国军需弹药出现短缺。监察员还发现，美国在相关物资补给方面存在瓶颈，意味着补充供应面临阻滞。上述调查结论与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普此前宣称美国供应“几乎无限”的说法并不一致。材料没有说明短缺涉及哪些弹药、规模多大或瓶颈如何形成。
detailEn: BBC News reports that a Pentagon inspector has confirmed that the war in Iran has led to shortfalls in US munitions. The inspector also identified a bottleneck in resupply, indicating that replenishing the supplies is constrained. The finding contrasts with President Donald Trump's claim that US supplies are “virtually limitless.” The supplied material provides no further details about the affected munitions or the logistics problem.

titleZh: 科索沃前总统塔奇被判战争罪，获刑25年
titleEn: Kosovo's ex-President Thaci convicted of war crimes, sentenced to 25 years in prison
summaryZh: 欧盟支持的法庭裁定科索沃前总统塔奇犯战争罪，判处25年监禁。
summaryEn: An EU-backed court convicted former Kosovo President Hashim Thaci of war crimes and sentenced him to 25 years in prison.
detailZh: NPR World报道称，欧盟支持的法庭已裁定科索沃前总统哈希姆·塔奇犯有战争罪，并判处其25年监禁。报道将相关罪行指向科索沃与塞尔维亚之间的战争时期，称这些罪行发生在科索沃为争取独立而进行的战争中。该材料未进一步说明案件细节或判决后的相关安排。
detailEn: According to NPR World, an EU-backed court convicted former Kosovo President Hashim Thaci of war crimes and sentenced him to 25 years in prison. The report says the crimes were committed during Kosovo’s war for independence from Serbia. The material identifies the defendant, the court’s EU backing, the conviction, the sentence, and the broader wartime context, but provides no further information about the specific charges, the proceedings, or any response from Thaci. This card therefore reports only the facts stated in the supplied RSS material.

titleZh: 沙特称针对麦加的未遂袭击是“红线”，胡塞否认
titleEn: Saudi Arabia Calls Attempted Mecca Attack a “Red Line”; Houthis Deny It
summaryZh: 沙特指责胡塞企图袭击麦加，胡塞否认，地区国家谴责但未现军事支持。
summaryEn: Saudi Arabia accused the Houthis of attempting to attack Mecca; the Houthis denied it, while regional countries condemned the incident.
detailZh: 据NPR World报道，沙特阿拉伯连夜指责也门获得伊朗支持的胡塞武装，称其企图袭击伊斯兰教最神圣的城市麦加，并将这一行动称为“红线”。胡塞方面否认实施袭击。相关指控引发该地区多个国家的谴责，但目前没有迹象显示这些国家提供军事支持。材料未说明袭击是否造成损失，也未提及后续军事行动或进一步证据。
detailEn: NPR World reports that Saudi Arabia accused Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi rebels overnight of attempting to attack Mecca, Islam’s holiest city, and described the alleged action as a “red line.” The Houthis denied carrying it out. The accusation prompted condemnation from several countries in the region, but there was no indication that any of them offered military support. The supplied material does not specify whether the attempted attack caused damage, nor does it provide details about the alleged operation, further evidence, or any subsequent military action.

titleZh: 土耳其政府称民众“枕下藏金”损害经济
titleEn: Turkish habit of stashing gold 'under the pillow' hurts economy, government says
summaryZh: 土耳其人因未雨绸缪和不信任银行而在家藏金，政府称此举损害经济。
summaryEn: Turks stash gold at home as a rainy-day safeguard and out of mistrust of banks; the government says the tradition hurts the economy.
detailZh: 据NPR World报道，多年来，许多土耳其人习惯把黄金藏在家中，以备不时之需；由于对银行缺乏信任，这一做法一直延续。如今，土耳其政府表示，这种被称为“枕下藏金”的传统正在损害经济。材料没有进一步说明这一传统造成的具体经济影响，也未提及政府拟采取的措施。
detailEn: NPR World reports that, for years, Turks have stored gold at home as protection for a rainy day. Their distrust of banks is identified as part of the reason for the practice. The Turkish government now argues that this familiar “under the pillow” habit is damaging the economy. The material does not provide further details about the nature of the damage or any government response.

titleZh: 土耳其家庭持金在银行体系外，或影响国家未来
titleEn: Gold Held Outside Banks May Hurt Turkey’s Future
summaryZh: 土耳其家庭持有数十亿美元黄金，政府欲将其纳入金融体系。
summaryEn: Turkey’s government wants households to move billions of dollars’ worth of gold into the financial system to help the economy.
detailZh: 土耳其不少家庭持有价值数十亿美元的黄金，并将其置于银行体系之外。对民众而言，黄金常被用作应对通胀的资产；但大量黄金未进入主流金融体系，可能正对土耳其的未来造成不利影响。政府希望说服公民把这些黄金纳入主流金融体系，借此帮助经济，并推动其进入金融体系。
detailEn: Turkish households hold gold worth billions of dollars outside the banking system. Many citizens view gold as a hedge against inflation, but its remaining outside mainstream finance may be hurting Turkey’s future. The government is seeking to persuade people to bring these holdings into the mainstream financial system, with the aim of helping the economy. The report presents this as a tension between households’ use of gold as an inflation hedge and the government’s effort to move it into mainstream finance.

titleZh: 报告称美国民主表现达50年测量以来新低
titleEn: State of U.S. Democracy Reaches New Low, Report Finds
summaryZh: 全球民主报告称美国民主表现降至50年测量以来最低。
summaryEn: A global democracy report says U.S. democratic performance is at its lowest level in 50 years of measurement.
detailZh: 一份新的全球民主报告指出，美国的民主表现已降至过去50年测量期间的最低水平。这意味着，在该报告所覆盖的五十年评估记录中，美国当前的民主表现处于最低点。现有材料未说明报告名称、发布机构、评估指标或具体排名，也没有提供这一结果背后的原因和更多背景。
detailEn: A new global democracy report says that the United States has reached its lowest level of democratic performance in the 50 years covered by the measurement. The finding places the U.S. at its weakest recorded point in the report’s five-decade assessment. The available material does not identify the report, its publisher, the indicators used, or any specific ranking. It also provides no explanation for the decline or additional context about how the assessment was conducted. The supplied summary offers no further details.

titleZh: “我们是猎物”：发现七名女性遗体引发南非对女性杀戮的愤怒
titleEn: ‘We are prey’: discovery of seven women’s bodies fuels anger over femicide in South Africa
summaryZh: 约翰内斯堡机场附近发现七名女性遗体，引发对女性杀戮的愤怒。
summaryEn: Seven women’s bodies found near Johannesburg airport, fueling anger over femicide.
detailZh: 南非约翰内斯堡国际机场附近发现七名女性遗体，其中五具在过去一周发现，引发恐惧、悲痛与愤怒，民众质疑打击女性杀戮缺乏进展。38岁的伊丽莎白“Tsontso”莫塞拉克戈莫9月9日外出跑步后未归，8岁女儿通知亲属，亲属联系警方。她的遗体于周六被发现，周一由亲属确认身份；其失踪消息此前在网上广泛传播。这些发现进一步加剧了对女性安全的担忧。
detailEn: The discovery of seven women’s bodies around Johannesburg’s international airport, including five in the past week, has triggered fear, grief and anger over a lack of progress in tackling femicide. Elizabeth “Tsontso” Moselakgomo, 38, failed to return after going for a run on 9 September. Her eight-year-old daughter alerted relatives, who contacted police. Moselakgomo’s body was found on Saturday and identified by relatives on Monday. News of her disappearance had gone viral. The material says the discoveries prompted an outpouring of fear, grief and anger.

titleZh: 非洲萨赫勒地区与基地组织、伊斯兰国关联暴力今年或创历史新高
titleEn: Al-Qaida- and IS-linked violence in Africa’s Sahel set to hit record levels this year
summaryZh: 数据显示，萨赫勒地区伊斯兰极端主义暴力今年或达历史高位。
summaryEn: Acled figures indicate Islamist extremist violence in Africa’s Sahel is set to reach historic highs this year.
detailZh: 据《卫报》援引冲突监测机构Acled汇编的新数据报道，非洲萨赫勒地区与基地组织及“伊斯兰国”有关联的团体发动一系列大规模攻势后，伊斯兰极端主义暴力今年或达到历史高位。报道指出，在美国纪念基地组织袭击华盛顿和纽约25周年之际，相关统计显示，该组织在非洲部分地区持续扩张，与其在其他地区相对势弱形成反差。
detailEn: The Guardian reports that new figures compiled by conflict monitor Acled indicate Islamist extremist violence in Africa’s Sahel region is set to reach historic highs this year. The projected rise follows a series of sweeping offensives by groups linked to al-Qaida and Islamic State. As the US marks the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks launched by al-Qaida against targets in Washington and New York, the figures underline the veteran organisation’s continued expansion in parts of Africa, contrasting with its relative weakness elsewhere.

titleZh: 研究发现：奴隶贸易财富嵌入英国金融体系
titleEn: Slave-trade wealth was embedded in Britain’s financial system, research finds
summaryZh: 研究称，英格兰银行及英国金融体系长期深度卷入奴隶贸易。
summaryEn: Research finds the Bank of England and Britain’s financial system were deeply involved for centuries in enslaving and trafficking millions of Africans.
detailZh: 英国历史学家编纂《英国奴隶贸易商名录》的新研究称，英格兰银行及英国金融体系数百年来深度参与奴役和跨大西洋贩运数百万非洲人。英格兰银行的数十名董事及创始认购者曾投资相关贸易，金融体系参与规模或超过此前所知或承认的程度。该行自1946年克莱门特·艾德礼领导的工党政府将其国有化后由政府拥有。
detailEn: New research by historians compiling the Register of British Slave Traders says the Bank of England and Britain’s financial system were deeply involved for centuries in the enslavement and transatlantic trafficking of millions of African people. Dozens of the bank’s directors and founding subscribers were significant investors in the trafficking of enslaved Africans. The researchers say the scale of the financial system’s involvement was greater than previously known or acknowledged. The Bank of England has been government-owned since its nationalisation in 1946 by Clement Attlee’s Labour administration.

titleZh: “我相信了那些炒作”：在美国被拒的南非白人难民
titleEn: ‘I believed the hype’: the white South Africans denied refugee status in the US
summaryZh: 特朗普推动接收南非阿非利卡人后，数十名申请者被拒，项目似乎放缓。
summaryEn: Dozens of Afrikaner refugee applicants have been rejected, as the US programme promoted by Trump appears to be slowing.
detailZh: 《卫报》报道，特朗普于2025年2月宣布美国将接收南非阿非利卡人作为难民后，许多相信自己在南非遭受种族主义的白人南非人认为愿望实现。然而近几个月，难民项目已有数十名申请者被拒，申请人感到失望和困惑，不明白为何仍要面对特朗普所谓南非“白人种族灭绝”的说法。报道指出，这项帮助数千名阿非利卡人的行动似乎正在放缓。
detailEn: The Guardian reports that after Donald Trump announced in February 2025 that the US would accept Afrikaners from South Africa as refugees, many white South Africans who believed they faced racism in their country thought their prayers had been answered. In recent months, however, dozens of applicants to the refugee programme have been rejected. Many were left dismayed and confused about why they would still have to face what Trump has falsely described as a “white genocide” in South Africa. The report says the drive to help thousands of Afrikaners appears to be showing signs of slowing.

titleZh: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情已达峰值，当局称感染率放缓
titleEn: Ebola outbreak in DRC has peaked, say authorities, as infection rates slow
summaryZh: 刚果（金）当局称埃博拉疫情已达峰值，感染放缓
summaryEn: DRC authorities say the Ebola outbreak has peaked as infection rates slow, but experts urge more action to control Bundibugyo.
detailZh: 刚果民主共和国当局宣布，正在该国部分地区肆虐的埃博拉疫情已达峰值。官员表示，自疫情于5月宣布以来，新增感染人数首次出现放缓。此次疫情已造成近3500人死亡。为实现控制目标，专家强调，仍需采取更多措施，确保Bundibugyo得到控制。
detailEn: Authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo say the Ebola outbreak ravaging parts of the country has peaked. Officials report that, for the first time since the epidemic was declared in May, the number of people becoming infected is slowing. Almost 3,500 people have died in the outbreak. Experts nevertheless say more must be done to ensure Bundibugyo is under control. The announcement pairs the reported peak and slower infection rates with experts’ call for continued efforts to maintain control.

titleZh: 英国通胀率升至3.1%，能源成本飙升
titleEn: UK Inflation Rises to 3.1% as Energy Costs Soar
summaryZh: 能源成本飙升推动英国通胀率升至3.1%，数据发布恰逢英国央行更新货币政策前一天。
summaryEn: UK inflation rose to 3.1% as energy costs soared, one day before the Bank of England updates its monetary policy.
detailZh: CNBC Economy报道称，英国通胀率升至3.1%，能源成本飙升与这一变化同时被提及。该读数公布之际，距离英国央行更新货币政策仅剩一天。材料没有提供此前通胀水平、具体能源项目、统计口径或数据发布时间，也没有说明英国央行更新政策时将作出何种决定。这则消息目前仅包含上述信息，尚不足以判断后续政策方向。
detailEn: CNBC Economy reports that UK inflation rose to 3.1%, with soaring energy costs cited alongside the increase. The reading was released one day before the Bank of England is due to update its monetary policy. The supplied material does not state the previous inflation rate, identify the specific energy costs involved, provide the statistical methodology or publication time, or say what policy decision the central bank may make. The item offers no further explanation of the policy outlook.

titleZh: 印度尼西亚新任财长面临财政可信度考验
titleEn: Indonesia's New Finance Minister Faces Uphill Battle on Fiscal Credibility
summaryZh: 纳扎拉在普尔巴亚被解职数小时后宣誓就任财长。
summaryEn: Nazara was sworn in after Purbaya’s dismissal, bringing seven years as deputy finance minister and prior fiscal-policy leadership.
detailZh: 据CNBC Economy报道，纳扎拉在普尔巴亚被解职数小时后宣誓就任印度尼西亚新任财政部长。标题称，新任财长面临维护财政可信度的艰巨任务。纳扎拉曾担任副财政部长七年，并于2015年至2019年领导财政部财政政策机构。材料未提供其政策议程、普尔巴亚被解职原因或当前财政挑战的进一步信息。
detailEn: According to CNBC Economy, Nazara was sworn in as Indonesia’s new finance minister hours after Purbaya was dismissed. The report frames the appointment as an uphill battle over fiscal credibility. Nazara previously served as deputy finance minister for seven years and led the ministry’s fiscal policy agency from 2015 to 2019. The available material provides no further details on Nazara’s policy agenda, the circumstances of Purbaya’s dismissal, or the specific fiscal challenges facing the ministry.

titleZh: 去美元化讨论为何更多停留在口头
titleEn: Why De-Dollarization Discussions Are More Talk Than Action
summaryZh: 金砖国家主张本币贸易，但去美元化仍更多停留在讨论层面。
summaryEn: BRICS leaders support local-currency trade, but de-dollarization remains more talk than action.
detailZh: CNBC Economy一篇报道指出，围绕“去美元化”的讨论，当前更多体现为倡议和表态，而非明确行动。金砖国家领导人已提出，应在金砖国家内部贸易中使用本币，以降低对美元的依赖。报道传达的核心，是推动成员间贸易减少对美元的依赖；但从标题所作判断看，相关讨论与实际行动之间仍存在距离。
detailEn: A CNBC Economy report examines why discussions about de-dollarization may remain more rhetorical than practical. BRICS leaders have asserted that local currencies should be used in trade among BRICS members, with the stated aim of reducing dependence on the dollar. The report frames this position as an expression of intent, while its headline emphasizes a gap between discussion and action. The material provided does not specify particular measures, timelines, or outcomes beyond the leaders’ stated support for local-currency trade.

titleZh: 统计票数：美联储预计加息之际，Warsh面临艰难较量
titleEn: Counting the votes: Warsh faces a tough battle as the Fed girds for expected interest rate hike
summaryZh: 交易员预计加息概率超92%，12月再加息概率超75%。
summaryEn: Traders priced in over 92% odds of a rate hike and over 75% odds of another increase in December.
detailZh: CNBC Economy报道称，围绕美联储预期加息的“投票”受到关注，Warsh面临一场艰难较量。交易员定价显示，加息概率超过92%；同时，12月再次加息的概率也超过75%。材料未说明具体投票结果、加息幅度或政策决定，仅呈现市场对两次加息可能性的预期。相关判断来自交易定价，而非已公布的最终结果。
detailEn: The CNBC Economy report presents the situation as a vote-counting contest: Warsh faces a tough battle while the Federal Reserve prepares for an expected rate hike. Market pricing indicated that traders assigned a probability of more than 92% to a rate increase. It also showed a probability above 75% for another increase in December. The material does not specify the size of any hike, the outcome of a vote, or a final policy decision; it only reports the probabilities reflected in traders’ pricing.

titleZh: 通胀再次超过工资增速，美国人薪资承压
titleEn: Inflation is outpacing wage growth again, squeezing Americans’ paychecks
summaryZh: 8月消费者价格同比上涨3.4%，工资上涨3.1%，通胀再次跑赢工资。
summaryEn: In August, consumer prices rose 3.4% year over year, while wages increased 3.1%, putting renewed pressure on Americans’ paychecks.
detailZh: CNBC Economy称，8月消费者价格较一年前上涨3.4%，工资同期上涨3.1%。从增速对比看，物价涨幅高于工资增幅0.3个百分点，显示通胀再次跑在工资增长之前，进一步挤压美国人的薪资。材料聚焦消费者价格与工资的年度涨幅，未提供更具体的价格项目、工资类别或后续变化。
detailEn: CNBC Economy reported that consumer prices in August were 3.4% higher than a year earlier, while wages rose 3.1%. The comparison shows that inflation outpaced wage growth by 0.3 percentage points, meaning prices increased faster than pay. This gap is putting pressure on Americans’ paychecks, as wage gains did not keep pace with the rise in consumer prices. The figures describe year-over-year changes for August only.

titleZh: 亚马逊在印度推出支持印地语的Alexa+
titleEn: Amazon launches Alexa+ in India with Hindi support
summaryZh: 亚马逊宣布Alexa+在印度开启早期体验，支持印地语和英语。
summaryEn: Amazon announced Alexa+ is available in India in Early Access, supporting Hindi and English.
detailZh: 亚马逊宣布，其对话式助手Alexa+现已在印度提供印地语支持。该助手能够进行更长时间的对话，并在交流过程中保持上下文。印度所有用户均可在早期体验阶段使用印地语和英语版本。关于早期测试结束后的安排，所给摘要在此处截断，未提供具体信息。
detailEn: Amazon announced that its Alexa+ conversational assistant is available in India with Hindi support. The assistant is designed to sustain conversations for longer and maintain context during those exchanges. According to the provided material, the feature is available to all customers in India through Early Access, in both Hindi and English. The source excerpt ends while describing what Amazon plans to do after the early testing period, so it does not provide further details about the next stage, timing, or rollout.

titleZh: 黄仁勋：不需要人工智能监管，安全应由企业负责
titleEn: We don’t need AI regulation — leave safety to us, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says
summaryZh: 黄仁勋称，AI安全可由产品制造商通过工程方式设计，无需监管。
summaryEn: Jensen Huang says AI safety can be engineered by product makers, arguing that AI regulation is unnecessary.
detailZh: 据TechCrunch报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋表示，不需要人工智能监管来处理安全问题，相关责任应交给各家人工智能产品制造商。他认为，人工智能并不是某种全新的“外星思维”，而只是由硬件和软件构成的技术，因此安全可以由开发产品的企业通过工程方式加以设计。材料未提及具体政策、监管安排或安全标准。
detailEn: TechCrunch reports that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang argued that AI does not require regulation and that safety should be left to the companies building AI products. Huang said AI is not a new form of an “alien mind”; rather, it consists of hardware and software. On that basis, he said safety can be engineered by each product maker. His position, as presented in the report, is that individual AI makers can address safety through product engineering. The report does not provide further details about specific regulations, safety standards, or policy measures.

titleZh: 人工智能数据中心扩张波及工业创伤城市
titleEn: AI Data Center Boom Collides With Cities Scarred by Industry
summaryZh: 数据中心建设引发的全国性反弹已波及费城。
summaryEn: National opposition to data center construction has spread to Philadelphia.
detailZh: TechCrunch报道，人工智能数据中心建设热潮正与曾受大型工业影响的城市发生碰撞。针对数据中心建设的全国性反对声浪已蔓延至费城。当地官员提出，可能在一个已受到一家现已停运炼油厂影响的社区开展建设。材料未说明项目是否最终获批、具体位置或建设时间。这一案例显示，数据中心扩张与社区既有工业影响之间的关系正受到关注。
detailEn: TechCrunch reports that the boom in AI data centers is colliding with cities already scarred by heavy industry. A national outcry over data center construction has spread to Philadelphia. City officials suggested that construction could take place in a neighborhood already affected by a now-defunct oil refinery. The material does not specify whether the proposal has been approved, the project's exact location, or its timeline. It presents the Philadelphia case as part of the broader debate over where new data center facilities should be built, without providing further details about the proposal or the community’s response.

titleZh: Meta开放WhatsApp Business AI代理处理繁琐设置
titleEn: Meta lets AI agents handle WhatsApp Business setup tasks
summaryZh: WhatsApp Business推出MCP服务器，支持AI代理处理设置、模板、测试和故障排查。
summaryEn: A new WhatsApp Business MCP server lets developers use AI coding agents for setup, templates, testing, and troubleshooting.
detailZh: 据TechCrunch报道，WhatsApp Business推出新的MCP服务器，允许开发者借助Claude、Cursor、Codex和ChatGPT等AI编程代理，处理业务设置、消息模板、测试及故障排查等工作。该工具面向开发者，重点覆盖WhatsApp Business配置过程中较为重复、繁琐的环节。材料未披露更多产品细节、具体技术实现或发布时间。
detailEn: TechCrunch reports that a new WhatsApp Business MCP server allows developers to use AI coding agents, including Claude, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT, to manage parts of the WhatsApp Business setup process. The agents can handle setup, messaging templates, testing, and troubleshooting. The report describes the server as a way to delegate routine or tedious configuration work to AI agents. The provided material does not give additional product details or a release date. No further claims are made in the source summary.

titleZh: AI墓地：未能成功的项目与初创公司持续名单
titleEn: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
summaryZh: TechCrunch盘点关闭或未达预期的AI项目与初创公司。
summaryEn: TechCrunch reviews AI projects and startups that shut down or fell short of expectations.
detailZh: TechCrunch发布一份持续更新的盘点，聚焦已经关闭或未达到预期的人工智能项目与初创公司。文章提到，苹果的Siri人工智能项目曾多次延期，OpenAI“超级应用”的发布则被形容为混乱。材料将这些案例放在同一份名单中，关注AI项目未能实现预期、停止推进或未能继续运营的情况。
detailEn: TechCrunch presents a running list of artificial-intelligence projects and startups that shut down or failed to meet expectations. The roundup mentions Apple’s repeatedly delayed Siri AI effort and characterizes OpenAI’s “super app” launch as messy. It places these examples in a broader list of AI initiatives whose expected results or continued progress did not materialize. The supplied summary offers no additional information about the projects’ timelines, causes, or final outcomes, so the article is presented here only as an overview of the cases identified by TechCrunch.

titleZh: 人脑“微蛋白”图谱或为阿尔茨海默病研究提供新线索
titleEn: Map of brain ‘microproteins’ could offer new clues to Alzheimer’s disease
summaryZh: 研究人员在人脑组织中发现逾1000种被忽视的微蛋白，其中一些在阿尔茨海默病中发生变化。
summaryEn: Researchers detect more than 1,000 overlooked microproteins in human brain tissue, including some altered in Alzheimer’s disease.
detailZh: 《自然》新闻报道，研究人员在人类脑组织中检测到逾1000种此前被忽视的微蛋白，并据此描绘脑内“微蛋白”图谱。其中一些微蛋白在阿尔茨海默病中发生变化。材料称，这一发现或可为该疾病研究提供新线索，但未说明具体涉及哪些蛋白、变化方式及其作用机制。相关报道于2026年9月16日在线发布，DOI为10.1038/d41586-026-02914-6。
detailEn: Nature News reports that researchers detected more than 1,000 previously overlooked microproteins in human brain tissue and mapped them. Some of these microproteins are altered in Alzheimer’s disease. The material says the findings could provide new clues for Alzheimer’s research, but it does not specify which proteins are involved, how they change or what roles they play. The report was published online on 16 September 2026, with DOI 10.1038/d41586-026-02914-6. The supplied material provides no further experimental, clinical or mechanistic details.

titleZh: AI公司应与科研界合作保护成果归属
titleEn: AI companies must work with the research community to protect attribution
summaryZh: 数学领域一项划时代主张引发AI工具如何致谢前人工作的讨论。
summaryEn: An era-defining mathematics claim raises questions about how AI tools credit earlier work.
detailZh: Nature News材料显示，《Nature》于2026年9月16日在线发表相关文章，呼吁AI公司与科研界合作，以保护研究成果的归属和对前人工作的致谢。文章称，一项被称为“划时代”的数学主张，正引发关于AI工具应如何为早期研究成果提供署名或致谢的疑问。材料未披露该数学主张的具体内容，也未说明相关AI工具或涉及的研究机构。文章DOI为10.1038/d41586-026-02886-7。
detailEn: According to the RSS material, Nature published an article online on 16 September 2026 titled “AI companies must work with the research community to protect attribution.” The article says an era-defining mathematics claim has raised questions about how AI tools credit earlier work. It calls for AI companies to work with the research community to protect attribution. The supplied material does not identify the mathematics claim, the AI tools involved, or any research institutions. The article’s DOI is 10.1038/d41586-026-02886-7. No further details are provided in the RSS summary.

titleZh: 这些奇异且备受追捧的微生物正揭示复杂生命的起源

summaryZh: 研究者争相培养奇特微生物，意外发现或揭示复杂生命起源。
summaryEn: Researchers race to culture exotic microbes, uncovering surprises that may illuminate the origins of complex life.
detailZh: 《Nature》于2026年9月16日在线发表报道，聚焦一批奇异且备受追捧的微生物。研究人员正竞相将这些奇特生物培养起来，并在推进过程中不断发现意外。文章将这些发现与探寻复杂生命起源联系起来。摘要没有提供具体微生物名称、实验结果或研究机构信息。DOI：10.1038/d41586-026-02849-y。
detailEn: Nature’s report, published online on 16 September 2026, focuses on researchers racing to culture a menagerie of bizarre, much-coveted microbes. The effort is yielding many surprises along the way and is being used to investigate the origins of complex life. The supplied material gives no names for the organisms, researchers or institutions, and provides no specific experimental results. The article’s DOI is 10.1038/d41586-026-02849-y. It describes a broad research push rather than detailing individual discoveries. This summary is limited to the headline and abstract.

detailEn: Nature lists a paper titled “Quality control of glycogen through direct ubiquitylation by RNF213,” published online on 15 September 2026. The DOI is 10.1038/s41586-026-11139-6. Based on the supplied RSS material, the paper concerns direct ubiquitylation by RNF213 in relation to glycogen quality control. The feed provides no information about the study’s methods, experimental results, mechanistic details, authors, or conclusions. detailEn: Nature News lists an “Author Correction” for the article “Erythropoietin receptor on cDC1s dictates immune tolerance.” The item was published online by Nature on 15 September 2026 and carries DOI 10.1038/s41586-026-11137-8. The supplied RSS entry identifies the notice as an author correction but does not describe what was corrected, how the original article changed, or any broader implications. This card therefore reports only the publication notice and bibliographic information available in the source, without inferring the nature or significance of the correction.

titleZh: 皇马球星疑似遮挡支持休达的信息
titleEn: Real Madrid stars appear to hide Ceuta solidarity message
summaryZh: 三名皇马球员疑似遮挡球衣上“我们都是卡巴亚斯”的支持休达信息。
summaryEn: Three Real Madrid players appeared to cover a “We are all Caballas” message on shirts showing solidarity with Spain’s Ceuta.
detailZh: 据半岛电视台报道，三名皇家马德里球员似乎遮挡了所穿球衣上的“我们都是卡巴亚斯”（We are all Caballas）字样。该信息用于表达对西班牙休达的声援。材料没有披露球员姓名、具体遮挡方式或事件发生时间，也没有说明相关方面是否作出回应。由于报道使用“似乎”描述，这一行为的意图目前不能被进一步确认。
detailEn: Al Jazeera reported that three Real Madrid players appeared to cover a “We are all Caballas” message on the shirts they wore. The message was presented as an expression of solidarity with Spain’s Ceuta. The available material does not identify the players, explain how the message was covered, or provide additional comments from the club or the players. Because the report describes the action as appearing to hide the message, the material does not establish the players’ intentions or confirm why it was covered. The item therefore describes an apparent action rather than a confirmed attempt to suppress or reject the solidarity message.

titleZh: 斯里兰卡名将鲁梅什·帕蒂拉盖的标枪在亚运会前损坏
titleEn: Sri Lankan star Rumesh Pathirage’s javelin broken ahead of Asian Games
summaryZh: 帕蒂拉盖从布达佩斯返程时，曾投出世界最佳距离的标枪损坏。
summaryEn: Pathirage’s javelins were broken on his flight back from Budapest.

detailEn: Al Jazeera reports that Sri Lankan javelin athlete Rumesh Pathirage’s javelins were broken during his flight back from Budapest. The report says the javelins were the equipment he used to throw a world-best distance. The incident occurred ahead of the Asian Games. The available material does not specify how the javelins were damaged, the extent of the damage, or what will happen to them next. It also provides no further information about the flight or Pathirage’s preparations for the Games.

titleZh: 乌克兰前线附近俄无人机袭击致至少5人死亡
titleEn: At least five killed in Russian drone strike near Ukraine front line
summaryZh: 乌克兰东南部尼科波尔附近遭袭，至少5死7伤。
summaryEn: A Russian drone strike near Nikopol in southeastern Ukraine killed at least five people and injured seven, according to the Dnipropetrovsk governor.
detailZh: 据半岛电视台报道，第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克州州长称，乌克兰东南部尼科波尔附近发生俄罗斯无人机袭击。袭击发生在乌克兰前线附近，已造成至少5人死亡，另有至少7人受伤。现有材料未说明袭击的具体时间、目标、伤者情况或是否还有其他损失，相关信息仅以州长说法为依据。
detailEn: Al Jazeera reports that a Russian drone strike occurred near Nikopol in southeastern Ukraine, close to the country’s front line. The governor of Dnipropetrovsk said at least five people were killed and at least seven others were injured. The supplied material gives no further details about the attack’s timing or specific target, the identities or conditions of those affected, or any additional damage beyond the reported casualties. It also contains no information about the circumstances of the strike beyond its location and the governor’s account.

detailEn: According to the Al Jazeera material, Palestinian human rights lawyer Noura Erakat was arrested in Florida after speaking at a hearing against an Israel Bonds investment.
